resources.name: SRIM (Stopping and Range of Ions in Matter)

access.notes: Publicly available; may require free registration. Use version 2008 or later to match the paper's calculation.

Lattice parameters and atomic positions for the apatite phases are available in crystallographic databases (ICSD, literature). Needed to compute target density for SRIM. An experienced user can approximate the density from formula and typical apatite densities if exact parameters are unavailable.
